user.title: Add a Tapo camera
user.description: Plays white, pink or ocean noise through the camera's own speaker. Tapo cameras need your TP-Link account password, which is checked with the camera on your network and never sent anywhere else. Third-Party Compatibility must be on in the Tapo app, under Me > Tapo Lab.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the camera. Check the IP address and that it's on this network.
error.not_tapo: That address doesn't answer like a Tapo camera.
error.third_party: The camera refused the password. Check it, and that Third-Party Compatibility is on in the Tapo app (Me > Tapo Lab).
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. The log has the detail.

abort.already_configured: This camera is already set up.
